corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez verbal noun is 'ጐየተ' (with labiovelar ጐ, matching 'አጐየዮ' on the next line), not 'ጉየተ'.
Amharic translation of Ge'ez 'ወሶበ ርእየ' ('when he saw') is 'ባየ ጊዜ' (4th order ባ), clearly visible in the print.
The proverbial Amharic expression reads 'ብስጩ ለልማዱ ካልጋው በመክዳው በቤተ ሰቡ' ('from his bed, on his pillow, on his household'), with 'ካ' (ከ+አልጋው) misread as 'ዛ'.
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 2:16 abbreviation for 'ዘክልኤቱ ዓመት' is printed 'ዘ፪ቱ ዓመት፤' with Phonetic complement 'ቱ', not 'ኤ'.
3rd person feminine singular compound perfective with object suffix is 'ረጭታዋለች' (4th order ታ), not 'ረጭተዋለች'.
Translating 'ውሉዳ' ('her children'), the printed glyph is 'ልጆችዋ' ('ችዋ' misread as 'ቹአ').
